title: SDG 2 消除飢餓
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #2 Zero Hunger 消除飢餓

slides.eyebrow_en: A Bilingual Lesson for Junior High Students

lines.en: I grew up in Compton, California.
lines.zh: 我在美國加州的 Compton 長大。

lines.en: Today I live and work in Taiwan.
lines.zh: 現在我住在台灣、在台灣工作。

lines.en: I won the UNA 2024 Young Leader of the Year Award.
lines.zh: 我獲得 2024 年聯合國協會青年領袖獎。

lines.en: Today we talk about food — and who doesn't have any.
lines.zh: 今天我們要談食物，還有那些沒有食物的人。

slides.ask_en: Raise your hand: who has been to another country?
That is a 13-hour flight. What would you miss most if you moved that far?
slides.ask_zh: 那是 13 小時的飛行。如果你搬那麼遠，最想念的會是什麼？

slides.note_en: Watch — then tell me one word you remember.
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我你記得的一個英文單字。

prompts.en: Stand up if you ate breakfast today.
prompts.zh: 今天有吃早餐的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you have EVER thrown away food.
prompts.zh: 曾經倒掉過食物的，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you threw away food THIS WEEK.
prompts.zh: 這個禮拜就倒掉過食物的，繼續站著。

slides.punch_en: Look around. This is why SDG 2 exists.
slides.punch_zh: 看看四周——這就是為什麼有 SDG 2。

slides.body_en: In 2015, every country in the world agreed on 17 Global Goals to reach by 2030. Goal number 2 is Zero Hunger — no one on Earth should go hungry.
slides.body_zh: 2015 年，全世界所有國家一起訂下 17 項全球目標，希望在 2030 年前達成。第 2 項就是「消除飢餓」——地球上不該有人挨餓。

slides.q_en: How many people in the world don't have enough food?
slides.q_zh: 全球有多少人沒有足夠的食物？
slides.explain_en: That's about 1 in every 11 people on Earth.
slides.explain_zh: 大約每 11 個人就有 1 人。

slides.head_en: of all the food in the world is never eaten
slides.head_zh: 全世界有三分之一的食物，從來沒被吃掉
slides.body_en: It is grown, harvested, shipped, cooked — and then thrown away.
slides.body_zh: 被種出來、採收、運送、煮好——然後被丟掉。
slides.ask_en: If we already grow enough food for everyone, why are people still hungry?
slides.ask_zh: 如果我們種的食物已經夠所有人吃，為什麼還有人挨餓？

slides.q_en: Food waste causes what share of the world's greenhouse gases?
slides.q_zh: 食物浪費製造了全球多少比例的溫室氣體？
slides.explain_en: If food waste were a country, it would be the 3rd biggest polluter on Earth.
slides.explain_zh: 如果「食物浪費」是一個國家，它會是全球第三大污染國。

slides.head_en: True or False? 快問快答

items.en: Hunger only happens in faraway countries.
items.zh: 飢餓只發生在很遠的國家。
items.note_en: It happens in every country — including Taiwan and the USA.
items.note_zh: 每個國家都有，包括台灣和美國。

items.en: Ugly vegetables are not safe to eat.
items.note_en: They taste the same. They are thrown away only for looks.
items.note_zh: 味道一樣，只是因為外表被丟掉。

items.en: Taking less food is one way to fight hunger.
items.zh: 少拿一點食物也是對抗飢餓的方法。
items.note_en: Take what you can finish — then take more if you're still hungry.
items.note_zh: 先拿吃得完的量，不夠再添。

items.en: One student cannot make any difference.
items.zh: 一個學生不可能造成任何改變。
items.note_en: This class alone eats about 15,000 school lunches a year.
items.note_zh: 光是這個班，一年就吃掉大約 15,000 份營養午餐。

slides.q_en: Where is the most food wasted?
slides.q_zh: 食物最常在哪裡被浪費？
slides.explain_en: More than half of all food waste happens at home — that means we can fix it ourselves.
slides.explain_zh: 超過一半的食物浪費發生在家裡——這代表我們自己就能改善。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many vegetables in English as you can. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多蔬菜越好，我來數！
slides.target_zh: 要打破的班級紀錄：15 個

slides.prompt_en: Tell your partner: what food do you NEVER finish at lunch? Why?
slides.prompt_zh: 告訴隔壁同學：營養午餐裡你最常吃不完的是什麼？為什麼？
slides.time_en: 60 seconds — then 3 pairs share with the class.
slides.time_zh: 60 秒，然後請 3 組跟全班分享。

slides.sub_en: Vote with your hands — 1, 2, 3, or 4 fingers.

items.en: Share extra food with a classmate
Tell your family what you learned today
items.zh: 回家告訴家人今天學到什麼

slides.reveal_en: There is no wrong answer — every one of these works. The biggest one is #4, because it multiplies.
slides.reveal_zh: 沒有錯的答案，四個都有效。最強的是第 4 個，因為它會擴散出去。

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Take only what you can finish.
Tell one person at home about SDG 2.
items.zh: 回家跟一個家人說 SDG 2。

slides.q_en: Which of these is a fruit, not a vegetable?
slides.q_zh: 下列哪一個其實是水果，不是蔬菜？
slides.explain_en: A tomato has seeds inside — that makes it a fruit!
slides.explain_zh: 番茄裡面有種子，所以在植物學上算水果！

slides.q_en: How long can most food last AFTER the 'best before' date?
slides.q_zh: 大部分食物過了「最佳賞味期限」之後，通常還能放多久？

options.en: It must be thrown away that day
Often still fine for days or weeks
options.zh: 常常還可以放好幾天甚至幾週

slides.explain_en: 'Best before' is about quality, not safety. Look, smell, then decide.
slides.explain_zh: 「最佳賞味期限」講的是品質，不是安全。看一看、聞一聞再決定。

slides.head_en: Bonus Game: Save It or Waste It?
slides.head_zh: 加碼遊戲：留下還是丟掉？
slides.rule_en: I say an item. Thumbs UP = we can still eat it. Thumbs DOWN = it must go.
slides.rule_zh: 我說一樣東西，大拇指向上＝還能吃，向下＝該丟了。

hints.en: Bread one day past the date
Soup left on the desk since yesterday

slides.target_en: Tap each item to reveal the answer.

slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到北斗國中那一欄，免註冊、免登入，直接留言跟 Teacher Dom 互動。

slides.big_en:
Be kind, be brave,
be the change.
slides.big_zh: 善良、勇敢，成為那個改變。
